EZ Duas Support

Need assistance, want to report an issue, or have an idea that would make EZ Duas better? Send us a message.

Email support
contact@issacodeworks.com

When reporting a problem

Please include your device model, operating-system version, EZ Duas app version, and a short description of what happened. Screenshots are helpful when available.

Frequently asked questions

Does EZ Duas require an account?
No. The app can be used without creating an account.

Where are my favorites and collections stored?
They are stored locally on your device. Deleting the app may also remove that locally stored information.

How can I report a correction?
Email us with the dua title, the text you believe needs attention, and any supporting reference you have.

Can I change the reading appearance?
Yes. Open Settings in EZ Duas to adjust appearance, text size, and Arabic typography.
